entities.summary: Seleucid, a notable figure in the history of Israel, associated with Second Temple Period (539 BCE–167 BCE). Preceded by Persian Return and Hellenistic Period. Their legacy influenced Maccabees and Hasmonean Kingdom and Maccabean.
